privacy.downloadText: Get a copy of what {{store}} keeps about you: your profile, addresses, orders with their invoices, refunds and returns, reviews, newsletter status, saved cart, and stock alerts. It downloads as a JSON file, a plain-text format other services can read.
privacy.cantUndo: This can't be undone. When you delete your account:
privacy.point1: you're signed out on every device, and your addresses, saved cart, and stock alerts are deleted;
privacy.point3: your past orders stay with us for our records (and the law), no longer linked to an account; your reviews stay with the name you used.
privacy.openOrders: Accounts with an order that's still on its way can't be deleted until it's delivered or cancelled.
